title: Electoral Intelligence: A Neural Zero-Inflated Negative Binomial Model for Forecasting Swedish Municipal Elections
abstract: arXiv:2611.08501v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting local elections is difficult because electoral competition is geographically heterogeneous, highly overdispersed, and characterized by many party-municipality combinations with little or no electoral activity. This article develops a bounded neural zero-inflated negative binomial (ZINB) model for forecasting party-level vote counts in Swedish municipal elections. The model combines a count component for expected votes, a zero-inflation component for structural electoral absence, municipality-specific dispersion, and learned embeddings capturing latent party, municipality, and party-municipality structure. Model training relies on data from the 2014, 2018, and 2022 Swedish municipal elections and performance is evaluated on a held-out set of municipalities. Testing results show strong predictive accuracy in both vote counts and vote shares. Explanatory diagnostics indicate that latent party structure, local party-municipality

translated_title: 选举智能：一种用于预测瑞典市政选举的神经零膨胀负二项模型
translated_abstract: 预测地方选举十分困难，因为选举竞争在地理上具有异质性、呈现高度过度分散的特征，并且许多政党-市政组合几乎没有或完全没有选举活动。本文开发了一个有界神经零膨胀负二项（ZINB）模型，用于预测瑞典市政选举中政党层面的得票数。该模型结合了四个部分：用于预测期望得票数的计数组件、用于刻画结构性选举缺席的零膨胀组件、市政特定的离散度，以及捕捉潜在政党、市政和政党-市政结构的可学习嵌入。模型训练依赖于2014年、2018年和2022年瑞典市政选举的数据，并在留出的市政数据集上评估其性能。测试结果表明，该模型在得票数和得票率两方面均表现出较强的预测准确性。解释性诊断表明，潜在政党结构、地方政党-市政（关系）等因素……
tldr: 本文提出了一种有界神经零膨胀负二项模型，通过融合计数组件、零膨胀组件与可学习嵌入，实现了对瑞典市政选举中政党层面得票数的高精度预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bounded neural zero-inflated negative binomial model that combines count, zero-inflation, and learned embedding components to achieve highly accurate forecasting of party-level vote counts in Swedish municipal elections.
